# Independent qualification — tester I

These fixtures, workers and assertions are authored independently from the native writer. Run only from a complete disposable package copy, with `python -B`, and direct databases, logs and reports to a new absolute external output directory. Source/profile IDs remain the writer's real IDs; tests do not patch caps or waive a refusal to claim minimum usefulness.

The independent oracle is the approved candidate/proposal and preflight A–L meanings, plus independently computed SQL byte/page and canonical record identities. Builder-supplied expected assertions are not acceptance evidence.

Required minimum: separate bounded A–L worlds, each with actual commit, fresh-process replay, promised sealed current/historical queries and exact oldest retry; a 16-admission mixed L1/L2 trace; explicit attribution versus actuality, acquisition versus access, receiver intake versus sender disclosure, provenance versus claimed source, holder-qualified three-valued support and unchanged expressed stance, case reopening with new retained tasks, fixed once-per-decision effect credit. Test unavailable/denied/missing equality, actor-local handles, metadata/count/order/cache sealing and read purity in paired worlds.

L0 regression mapping covers all 27 original C1 method obligations and 20 B01 cases as applicable native semantics/boundaries. The new proof retains donor remap/rebind/unload/reload/tombstone and qualified/resolve behavior under its new namespace/root; those controls require fresh execution. Old-world compatibility remains excluded. Exact root/source/ref identity, retention and retry guarantees require new proof. Evidence names actual execution, failure and unrun scope separately.

M0 acceptance requires closed API/data fields, actual fault seams, independent raw storage access and detached actor/author views. M4 covers captured mutability, wrong caller/world/incarnation/result, retry before staleness, reentrancy, before-write/before-commit/COMMIT-entry/after-commit/after-ack process windows, uncertainty reconciliation, full-prefix/source/policy/receipt/support corruption, optional ignored-invalid accelerators, exact numeric boundaries and coupled future feasibility. Actual RSS/tracemalloc/latency/storage/work are measured, never inferred from ceilings. Device power-loss, whole-volume exhaustion and general malicious-plugin isolation remain outside this qualification.

No independent acceptance exists before these tests actually run against a frozen candidate. Gate B remains an owner decision.
